result.title: TLRS-DPO: Token-Level Risk Scoring for Better Direct Preference Optimization
result.summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is a simple and widely used alternative to RLHF for aligning large language models (LLMs), but its sequence-level objective cannot precisely locate or suppress the local patterns that make an otherwise acceptable response unsafe or undesirable. We propose TLRS-DPO (Token-Level Risk Scoring for Better Direct Preference Optimization), which augments DPO with fine-grained token-level control while remaining fully offline and reference-based. TLRS-DPO introduces a token-level robust compensation term that converts the policy-reference log-ratio on rejected responses into localized risk scores, a curriculum-style schedule that gradually increases the strength of this compensation during training, and a risk-adaptive screening mechanism that selectively penalizes only high-risk tokens instead of entire sequences. This design bridges sequence-level preference fitting and token-level behavior control, and can be implemented as a drop-in modification to standard DPO trainers. Empirically, TLRS-DPO improves alignment quality and safety-relevant behavior with minimal impact on helpfulness compared to strong DPO baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 针对 DPO 序列级目标无法定位局部不安全模式的问题，提出 TLRS-DPO：把被拒响应上的 policy-reference log-ratio 转成 token 级风险分数，配合课程式补偿强度调度与只惩罚高风险 token 的自适应筛选，作为标准 DPO 训练器的即插即用改动。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 token 级风险打分与选择性惩罚可能为 latent 推理轨迹的贡献分配和监督粒度提供线索，可供核查这类风险分数能否用于定位推理中起负面作用的中间步骤；与视觉或多模态推理本身无直接联系。
